# Phase 5 Step 2: Dashboard Tabs — Costumes, Props & Lenses

This guide covers the render logic for all three data tabs including cards, filter bar, status badges, and add/delete actions.

---

## Costume Tab

### Costume Card Structure

Each costume is rendered as a card with:

```html
<!-- Generated by renderCostumes() -->
<div class="costume-card">
  <div class="card-image">
    <img src="/uploads/img_xxx.webp" alt="character">
    <!-- or placeholder if no image -->
    <div class="image-placeholder">👘</div>
  </div>
  <div class="card-body">
    <div class="card-header">
      <span class="badge badge-success">In Possession</span>
      <button class="btn-icon" onclick="deleteCostume('uuid')">🗑️</button>
    </div>
    <h3 class="card-title">Raiden Shogun</h3>
    <p class="card-subtitle">Genshin Impact · XS</p>
    <div class="completion-bar">
      <div class="completion-fill" style="width: 75%"></div>
    </div>
    <p class="completion-label">75% complete</p>
    <div class="card-footer">
      <a href="https://taobao.com/..." target="_blank" class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm">
        🛒 Taobao
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

### `renderCostumes()` Implementation

```javascript
function renderCostumes(items = state.costumes) {
  const grid = document.getElementById('costume-grid');
  if (!grid) return;

  if (items.length === 0) {
    grid.innerHTML = `
      <div class="empty-state">
        <p>👘 No costumes found</p>
        <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openModal('modal-add-costume')">Add your first costume</button>
      </div>`;
    return;
  }

  grid.innerHTML = items.map(item => {
    const completion = calculateCompletion(item);
    const badge = statusBadge(item.status);
    const image = getFirstImage(item.imageUrls);
    const taobaoBtn = item.referenceUrl
      ? `<a href="${item.referenceUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm">🛒 Taobao</a>`
      : '';

    return `
      <div class="costume-card">
        <div class="card-image">
          ${image
            ? `<img src="${image}" alt="${escapeHtml(item.character)}" loading="lazy">`
            : `<div class="image-placeholder">👘</div>`
          }
        </div>
        <div class="card-body">
          <div class="card-header-row">
            <span class="badge ${badge.cls}">${badge.label}</span>
            <button class="btn-icon" onclick="deleteCostume('${item.id}')" title="Delete">🗑️</button>
          </div>
          <h3 class="card-title">${escapeHtml(item.character)}</h3>
          <p class="card-subtitle">${escapeHtml(item.fandom)}${item.size ? ' · ' + escapeHtml(item.size) : ''}</p>
          <div class="completion-bar" title="${completion}% complete">
            <div class="completion-fill" style="width: ${completion}%"></div>
          </div>
          <p class="completion-label">${completion}% complete</p>
          <div class="card-footer">
            ${taobaoBtn}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }).join('');
}
```

### Status Badge Helper

```javascript
function statusBadge(status) {
  const map = {
    'IN_POSSESSION': { cls: 'badge-success', label: 'In Possession' },
    'ON_RENT':       { cls: 'badge-info',    label: 'On Rent' },
    'TO_BE_SOLD':    { cls: 'badge-warning', label: 'For Sale' },
    'WISHLIST':      { cls: 'badge-purple',  label: 'Wishlist' }
  };
  return map[status] || { cls: 'badge-secondary', label: status };
}
```

### Delete Costume

```javascript
async function deleteCostume(id) {
  if (!confirm('Delete this costume? This cannot be undone.')) return;
  try {
    await api(`/api/costumes/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
    showToast('Costume deleted', 'success');
    await loadCostumes();
  } catch (err) {
    showToast('Delete failed: ' + err.message, 'error');
  }
}
```

## Props Tab

### Prop Card Structure

```javascript
function renderProps(items = state.props) {
  const grid = document.getElementById('props-grid');
  if (!grid) return;

  if (items.length === 0) {
    grid.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-state"><p>⚔️ No props yet</p></div>`;
    return;
  }

  const categoryIcon = {
    'Weapon':    '⚔️',
    'Wig':       '👑',
    'Armor':     '🛡️',
    'Accessory': '💎',
    'Headpiece': '🎭',
  };

  grid.innerHTML = items.map(item => {
    const icon = categoryIcon[item.category] || '📦';
    const location = item.location ? `<span class="location-tag">📍 ${escapeHtml(item.location)}</span>` : '';
    const condition = item.condition ? `<span class="condition-tag">${escapeHtml(item.condition)}</span>` : '';

    return `
      <div class="prop-card">
        <div class="prop-icon">${icon}</div>
        <div class="prop-body">
          <h3 class="card-title">${escapeHtml(item.name)}</h3>
          <p class="card-subtitle">${item.category || 'Uncategorized'}</p>
          <div class="prop-tags">
            ${location}
            ${condition}
          </div>
          ${item.costumeId ? `<p class="prop-linked">🔗 Linked costume</p>` : ''}
        </div>
        <button class="btn-icon" onclick="deleteProp('${item.id}')">🗑️</button>
      </div>`;
  }).join('');
}
```

## Contact Lens Tab

### Lens Expiry Calculation

```javascript
function getLensStatus(lens) {
  if (!lens.expiryDate) return { label: 'Unknown', cls: 'badge-secondary', days: null };

  const now = new Date();
  const expiry = new Date(lens.expiryDate);
  const days = Math.ceil((expiry - now) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));

  if (days < 0)    return { label: 'Expired', cls: 'badge-danger', days };
  if (days <= 14)  return { label: `⚠️ ${days}d left`, cls: 'badge-warning', days };
  if (lens.isOpened === '1' || lens.isOpened === true || lens.status === 'ACTIVE')
                   return { label: `Active · ${days}d`, cls: 'badge-info', days };
  return           { label: `Sealed · ${days}d`, cls: 'badge-success', days };
}
```

### Lens Card Render

```javascript
function renderLenses(items = state.lenses) {
  const grid = document.getElementById('lenses-grid');
  if (!grid) return;

  if (items.length === 0) {
    grid.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-state"><p>👁️ No contact lenses registered</p></div>`;
    return;
  }

  // Sort by days remaining (most urgent first)
  const sorted = [...items].sort((a, b) => {
    const da = new Date(a.expiryDate) - new Date();
    const db = new Date(b.expiryDate) - new Date();
    return da - db;
  });

  grid.innerHTML = sorted.map(item => {
    const { label, cls } = getLensStatus(item);
    const canOpen = item.isOpened !== '1' && item.isOpened !== true && item.status !== 'ACTIVE';

    return `
      <div class="lens-card">
        <div class="lens-header">
          <span class="badge ${cls}">${label}</span>
          <span class="lens-color-dot" style="background: ${item.color?.toLowerCase() || '#888'}"></span>
        </div>
        <h3 class="card-title">${escapeHtml(item.color)}</h3>
        <p class="card-subtitle">${escapeHtml(item.character || 'Unassigned')}</p>
        <p class="lens-brand">${escapeHtml(item.brand || '')}${item.prescription ? ' · ' + item.prescription : ''}</p>
        <p class="lens-expiry">Expires: ${formatDate(item.expiryDate)}</p>
        <div class="lens-actions">
          ${canOpen
            ? `<button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" onclick="markLensOpened('${item.id}')">👁️ Mark as Opened</button>`
            : ''
          }
          <button class="btn-icon" onclick="deleteLens('${item.id}')">🗑️</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }).join('');
}
```

### Mark Lens as Opened

```javascript
async function markLensOpened(id) {
  try {
    await api(`/api/lenses/${id}/open`, { method: 'PATCH' });
    showToast('Lens marked as opened — expiry recalculated', 'success');
    await loadLenses();
  } catch (err) {
    showToast('Failed: ' + err.message, 'error');
  }
}
```

## Filter Bar

```javascript
function filterItems() {
  const query = state.filterQuery.toLowerCase();
  const status = state.filterStatus;

  if (state.currentTab === 'costumes') {
    const filtered = state.costumes.filter(c => {
      const matchText = !query ||
        c.character?.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        c.fandom?.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        c.brand?.toLowerCase().includes(query);
      const matchStatus = status === 'all' || c.status === status;
      return matchText && matchStatus;
    });
    renderCostumes(filtered);
  } else if (state.currentTab === 'props') {
    const filtered = state.props.filter(p =>
      !query ||
      p.name?.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      p.category?.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      p.location?.toLowerCase().includes(query)
    );
    renderProps(filtered);
  } else if (state.currentTab === 'lenses') {
    const filtered = state.lenses.filter(l =>
      !query ||
      l.color?.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      l.character?.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      l.brand?.toLowerCase().includes(query)
    );
    renderLenses(filtered);
  }
}
```

## Utility Functions

```javascript
// Prevent XSS when injecting into innerHTML
function escapeHtml(str) {
  if (!str) return '';
  return String(str)
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

// Format ISO date string to readable form
function formatDate(isoStr) {
  if (!isoStr) return '—';
  return new Date(isoStr).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {
    day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric'
  });
}

// Get first image URL from JSON string or array
function getFirstImage(imageUrls) {
  try {
    const parsed = typeof imageUrls === 'string' ? JSON.parse(imageUrls) : imageUrls;
    return Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0 ? parsed[0] : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
```

## Toast Notification System

```javascript
function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
  const toast = document.createElement('div');
  toast.className = `toast toast-${type}`;
  toast.textContent = message;
  document.body.appendChild(toast);
  
  // Animate in
  requestAnimationFrame(() => toast.classList.add('visible'));

  // Auto-dismiss after 3s
  setTimeout(() => {
    toast.classList.remove('visible');
    setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 300);
  }, 3000);
}
```

```css
.toast {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 24px;
  right: 24px;
  padding: 12px 20px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  transform: translateY(20px);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  z-index: 9999;
}
.toast.visible { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; }
.toast-success { background: var(--success); color: white; }
.toast-error   { background: var(--danger);  color: white; }
.toast-info    { background: var(--info);    color: white; }
```
